question: Blue + coral is in (round-013 b, now in theme.css). Now challenge the blue: which main color should sit next to coral? Surfaces, coral and status colors stay; only the primary (buttons, picked badge, washes, focus ring) changes.

variants.label: Blue (today)
variants.changes: Control: round-013 b exactly as now in theme.css. Blue primary (hue 262), coral accent.

variants.label: Indigo ink
variants.changes: Deeper, inkier blue leaning violet (hue 275). Less bright than today, more serious next to coral.

variants.label: Teal
variants.changes: Teal primary (hue 190), coral's complement: warm and cool in balance. The green status color moves to a truer green so it does not clash.

variants.label: Coral leads
variants.changes: Swap roles: coral becomes the primary, blue drops to the second color (accent and first status color). The warmest option.
